claims.summary: For d>=4 in every odd characteristic, the generic w6=0 branch orders of V_(6,d) are the A=16d-16 even orders 0,2,...,2A-2 and B=16d-32 odd orders 1,3,...,2B-1. Their binomial determinant is 2^120 H_d, where H_d=product_(1<=i<=j<=15)(32d-64+i+j)/(i+j) is integral. If p does not divide H_d, original dimension-six generic normality follows. Exact unit classes are determined by the recorded residue table at p-powers <=30 and avoidance of residues 2,...,30 by -32(d-2) modulo the first p-power >30. This includes ten classes modulo81 at p=3 and all p>32d-34; failure of the unit test is not nonnormality.
claims.assessment: Working application of the completed dimension-five theorem to the existing exact joint-leading-coefficient identity. The actual branch profile and its Vandermonde ratio recover the same dyadic Catalan scalar. An exhaustive fixed 120-pair table proves every valuation level nonnegative and gives the exact finite unit-class criterion, checked against all 2565 small-prime period residues. Remaining residue classes need another coupled coefficient.
claims.rationale: Proves unbounded degree families at every odd prime in dimension six, including ten residue classes at characteristic three beyond the previous large-prime bands. The classical Catalan identity and joint coefficient are reused, with no separate novelty claim for those ingredients.
claims.next_action: Analyze an actual moving-point or less degenerate coefficient on the complementary characteristic-three degree classes, retaining the full marked source.

conj:cube-refined-initial-segment-law.assessment: Conjecture in the remaining n>=6 small-prime range outside established subranges. Proved in characteristic zero for all n,d; in every characteristic not two for n<=5 and d>=2; for p>2^(n-1)d; and in the recorded periodic bands d=b+tp with b>=n-2 and p>2^(n-1)b, including the stated residue intervals. Degree-one orders retain the separate Catalan law. Generic normality does not determine pre-stable threshold degrees. At n=6,d>=4 the exact Catalan-unit classes are proved, including ten degree classes modulo81 at p=3 and all p>32d-34; failure of this sufficient unit test does not imply nonnormality.

cor:cube-six-paired-large-primes.assessment: Working proof from the exact paired limit with common pole divisor degree 32d-24, p-adic closure for orders below p, affine transport of the mark preserving its polynomial character blocks, and safe confluence transfer. Improves the previous sufficient bound p>32d but leaves the small-prime determinant open. This range is now subsumed by thm:cube-six-branch-certificate, whose large-prime consequence is p>32d-34.
